positions.P3: the last token (the read's appended space token, before the answer)

arm_text.swap: his J-part swap: h_O - J10(h_O) + J10(h_S), J10 the projection on the state's own top-10 lens directions (O's protected rows; jswap's swap)
arm_text.swap_rand: a random part of Δ = h_S - h_O at the swap's share of ||Δ||^2 (capped at 1; seed 888 + layer)
arm_text.swap_rot: his own control (jswap's swap_rot): h_O + (J10(h_S) - J10(h_O)) R^T, R the layer's random orthogonal matrix (seed 888 + layer): the swap's change at its own size in a random direction
arm_text.jpp1: h_O + P_J Δ, the change's 25-atom signed OMP J++ part (49.1's J(1,0))
arm_text.rand1: h_O + R Δ, X0's random part of Δ at P_J Δ's share (49.1's R(1,0))
arm_text.whole: h_O <- h_S (Δ added; the whole state patched)
arm_text.ko: his knock-out at P3: the top-10 lens span removed at every layer of the band (peak +- 2)
arm_text.ko_rand: a random subspace part of the share his removal takes, at P3, every band layer
arm_text.jrm: at the peak layer, P3's state minus its projection on Δ's 25 OMP atoms there (47.5's zeroing)
arm_text.jrm_rand: a random subspace of the same share of ||h_O||^2 (47.5's random)

inputs_text.thru: the projection on his top-10 span (through the lens)
inputs_text.out: the residual minus that projection (outside the lens)

rule.read: through-the-lens probe >= 0.8 and lens top-5 >= 0.5 at some layer before the answer digit's layer, while the full-residual probe >= 0.9 there
rule.write: at the layer of the read peak, his swap or the J++ part of the change (gain <= 2) switches >= 0.5 of what the whole-state patch switches at that layer, with the random part <= 0.10
rule.a: in J-space: read holds and write holds
rule.b: readable, not used: read holds, write fails
rule.c: routes around J-space: through-the-lens < 0.5 at every layer before the answer while the full residual >= 0.9 at some layer, and write fails
rule.d: not represented: the full-residual probe < 0.5 at every layer before the answer

items_rule: every item of the source X0 run at L (x47_cumulative.select, as 49.1) for the read statistics (probes need the rows), decided on 49.1's locker-first items; write and remove arms on the locker-first items only
lens_dictionary: his read directions: x49_ladder.band_dictionaries (LensDictionary over W_g = W_U[letters] x the final norm's gain and J_l of the J++ lens, rows cast on demand), letter tokens; protected rows = the prompt's clean read's top-10 (x47_twodefs.protected_rows)
read: X0's chat read: the prompt with a digit's space token appended; switch = the top token over the vocabulary is S's answer's first token; kept = O's
gate: the source run's (X0: 0.8 per reader on O unedited, >= 150 eligible); asserted

seeds.folds: x0_probe.folds round robin by O's bridge (deterministic)

storage: states.npz: fp16 states and projections, gitignored (> 50 MB)
